summary: @or-sdk/discovery preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifiers and per-function string dictionaries, and at install time it downloads the Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it via execFileSync to run the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated blob (rotated string/number array with a `WV8StW` shift-decoder) with no relation to the package's advertised service-discovery SDK purpose. The pattern uses an alternate language runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload that Node-based tooling cannot readily inspect, giving install-time code execution on the installer's host from opaque, non-auditable content.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
